caption: A bicycle resting on its kickstand is hit by a stray soccer ball and falls over onto its side.

sa.check: A bicycle rests on its kickstand.
A soccer ball hits the bicycle.
The bicycle falls over onto its side.
The hit comes first and the fall follows.

pc.expect: The bike rocks at the hit, leans further, and falls on the side away from the kickstand's support.
pc.fail: The bike falls toward the kickstand side, over the stand; or it rights itself after leaning; or it falls before the ball arrives.

pc.expect: Once past its balance the bike goes down until it hits the ground and stays there.
pc.fail: The bike hangs leaning in mid-fall; or it rises; or it bounces back upright.

pc.expect: The ball's arrival is what moves the bike, and the ball rebounds or drops after hitting.
pc.fail: The ball passes the bike without touching it and the bike falls anyway; or the ball hits and stops dead in the air; or the ball sticks to the bike.

pc.expect: The frame stays rigid, the wheels may spin, the kickstand may fold.
pc.fail: The frame bends; or the bike bounces high off the ground; or a wheel squashes.

pc.expect: One bicycle and one ball keep their number and shape.
pc.fail: The bike vanishes or a second one appears; or the ball passes through the frame; or the bike turns into another object.

pc.expect: The bike's colour, the ball and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The bike changes colour; or the ball changes size; or the background rearranges.
